##### 5.1.2.9 Manage the users of an organization

On the Users tab of the Organizations page, you can manage the users of an organization and its subordinate organizations.

**Create a user**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.
4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the
organization that you want to manage and click its name.
5. On the right side of the **Organizations** page, click the **Users** tab.
6. On the **Users** tab, click **Create User**.
7. In the **Create User** dialog box, configure the parameters. For more information, see Create
users.
8. Click **OK**.

**View users and user details**

1. On the **Users** tab, view the users in the current organization. You can search for a user by
username above the user list.

> **Note:** If you select the root organization, the users of all organizations are displayed.

2. Find the user that you want to view and click its name to go to the **User Details** page.

| Section or tab | Description |
|---|---|
| Basic information | In the upper part of the User Details page, you can view the basic information about the user, including the following parameters: User Name, Display Name, Password, Organization, UID, Mobile Phone Number, Landline, Email Address, Most Recent Login, External System Association, DingTalk Token, Remarks, User Role, User Group Role, Access Method, and Multi-Cloud Role. Note The valid value of the Access Method parameter is Console Access. |
| Resource Set | This tab displays the resource sets to which the user is added. For more information, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong. |
| User Group | This tab displays the user groups to which the user is added. For more information, see Manage the user groups to which a user belongs. You can search for a user group by user group name above the user group list. |
| Role Permissions | This tab displays the information about the preset, custom, and Resource Access Management (RAM)-based batch authorization roles that are assigned to the user. In the Preset Roles & Custom Roles section, select a role from the drop-down list to view the permissions of the role. In the RAM Authorization section, view the RAM-based batch authorization roles that are assigned to the user. |

**Disable a user**

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the **Enabled** state.

**Limits**

You cannot disable proxy administrators on the Users tab. To disable a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then disable the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.
1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to disable and click **Disable** in the Actions
column.
2. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the associated AccessKey pairs
and the impacts after you disable the user. After you evaluate the impacts, select **I have**
**known the risks and confirm this operation**.

**Important**

When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > Permissions > **AccessKey Logs**.

> After you disable a user, the user is forbidden from logging in to the Apsara Uni- manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are disabled, and the user login status becomes invalid. After an AccessKey pair is disabled, the services or applications that reference the AccessKey pair may not run as expected. In this case, enable the user to restore the services or applications.

3. Click **Disable**. After the user is disabled, the user enters the **Disabled** state.

**Enable a user**

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the **Disabled** state.

**Limits**

You cannot enable proxy administrators on the Users tab. To enable a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then enable the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.
1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to enable and click **Enable** in the **Actions**
column.
2. In the message that appears, view the information about AccessKey pairs and click **OK**.
After the user is enabled, the user enters the **Enabled** state.

> **Note:** After a user is enabled, the associated AccessKey pairs are also enabled.

**Delete a user**

**Limits**

You cannot delete proxy administrators on the Users tab. To delete a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then delete the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.
1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to delete and click **Delete** in the Actions
column.
2. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the associated AccessKey pairs
and the impacts after you delete the user. After you evaluate the impacts, select **I have**
**known the risks and confirmed this delete operation**.

**Important**

When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > Permissions > **AccessKey Logs**.

> After you delete a user, the user is forbidden from logging in to the Apsara Uni- manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are deleted, and the user login status becomes invalid. The deleted user data cannot be restored. After an AccessKey pair is deleted, the services or applications that reference the AccessKey pair may not run as expected. Before you delete a user, we recommend that you disable the user first and troubleshoot issues.

3. Click **Delete**.

##### 5.1.2.11 Manage multi-cloud organizations

On the Multi-Cloud Organizations tab of the Tenant Management page, you can manage multi-cloud organizations.

**Constraints**

The Multi-Cloud Organizations tab appears only in level-1 organizations. On the **Public Cloud** tab of the **Multi-Cloud Management** page under **Native Hybrid**
**Cloud** > **Configuration**, platform administrator users can enable Allow Binding to Multiple
Level-1 Organizations for resource pools of the independent primary account type. This switch is disabled by default. After you enable it, the setting takes permanent effect and requires O&M operations to disable. When the switch is on: Multiple level-1 organizations can bind to the same public cloud primary account. When the switch is off: Existing mappings where multiple level-1 organizations bind to the same public cloud primary account remain intact. You can manually unbind them. Simultaneously, binding multiple level-1 organizations to the same public cloud primary account is prohibited. A level-1 organization can bind to only one resource account. A resource account can bind to only one level-1 organization.

**Bind multi-cloud organizations**

**Prerequisites**

The platform administrator user has completed multi-cloud access in **Configuration** >
**Native Hybrid Cloud** > **Multi-Cloud Management**.
You are an operations administrator user. You have either bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack or bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Resources** > **Tenant Management**.
4. On the **Tenant Management** page, click the name of a level-1 organization in the left-side
organizational structure.
5. On the right side, click the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab.
6. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization**.
7. In the **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization** dialog box, select the resource pool information
that you want to bind.

**Bind Apsara Stack organization**

| Configuration item | Description |
|---|---|
| Organization | Shows the name of the current organization. You cannot modify it. |
| Resource pool | Select the resource pool that you want to bind. |
| Organization | If the resource pool that you bind is of the Apsara Stack type, select an organization for the resource pool. |

**Bind public cloud organization**

| Configuration item | Description |
|---|---|
| Organization | Shows the name of the current organization. You cannot modify it. |

| Resource pool | Select the resource pool that you want to bind. If the bound resource pool is of the resource directory management account type, select a child resource pool, which is a resource account. If no resource account is available, click Create Resource Pool and add a resource account in the dialog box. |
|---|---|
| Alibaba Cloud Account ID | If the bound resource pool is of the public cloud type, shows the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You cannot modify it. |

**Bind standalone primary account**

**Bind resource account under resource directory management account**

8. Click **Confirm**. The multi-cloud organization binding is complete.
9. In the **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization** dialog box, click **Cancel** or **Bind Resource Set**.
Click **Cancel**: Return to the multi-cloud organization management list. You can view the bound resource pools in the list.

> **Note:** When the bound multi-cloud organization is of the Apsara Stack type, the **Apsara Stack organization name/Aliyun account name** column displays the organization name of the Apsara Stack.
> When the bound multi-cloud organization is of the public cloud type, the **Apsara Stack organization name/Aliyun account name** column displays the primary account of the public cloud.

Click **Bind Resource Set**: Go to the **Resource Sets** page. Bind multi-cloud resource sets for resource sets under this organization.

**Unbind a multi-cloud organization**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization has been bound to a multi-cloud organization or primary account. You are an operations administrator. You have either bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack, or bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.
1. On the **Tenant Management** page, click the name of the level-1 organization in the left-
side organizational hierarchy.
2. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Unbind** in the **Actions** column of the
resource pool.
3. In the dialog box, click **Unbind**. The multi-cloud organization is unbound successfully.
After unbinding, the system also unbinds all resource set bindings within the scope of the current organization and deletes all users or RAM roles created under this organization that were mapped to the corresponding resource pool and central cloud.

**Create and bind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization has been bound to a multi-cloud organization or primary account. To create and bind an Apsara Stack resource set, you must be an operations administrator who has bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack or a level-1 organization administrator who has bound the organization administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack. To create and bind a public cloud resource set, you must be an operations administrator who has bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level or a level-1 organization administrator who has bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.
1. On the **Organization Management** page, click the name of a level-1 organization in the
left-side organizational structure.
2. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Create Resource Set** in the **Actions**
column of the resource pool.
3. In the **Create and Associate Multi-cloud Resource Set** dialog box, configure the
resource set or resource group.

**Create and associate an Apsara Stack resource set**

| Configuration Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Organization to Associate | Select the central cloud organization to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
| Resource Set to Associate | Select the central cloud resource set to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
| Destination Resource Pool | The system displays the selected Apsara Stack of the subordinate cloud. You cannot modify it. |
| Destination Resource Set Name | Enter a name for this new resource set. |
| Destination Organization | Select the organization in the destination resource pool to which this new resource set belongs. |
| Security Level Based Access | Select a security level for this new resource set. Note This option appears only when security level-based access is enabled for the destination resource pool. |

**Create and associate a public cloud resource group**

| Configuration Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Organization to Associate | Select the central cloud organization to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
| Resource Set to Associate | Select the central cloud resource set to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
| Destination Resource Pool | The system displays the selected public cloud. You cannot modify it. |
| Destination Resource Group ID | Enter an identifier for this new resource group. Note The identifier must be 3 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter. You cannot modify the resource group identifier after the resource group is created. |

| Destination Resource Group Name | Enter a name for this new resource group. Note The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, Chinese characters, or digits. |
|---|---|

4. Click **Confirm.**

**Related operations**

Operations and documentation related to multi-cloud access:
1. Multi-Cloud Management.
2. Manage multi-cloud resource sets.
3. Modify multi-cloud roles.
4. Manage the resource sets to which users belong.

#### 5.1.3 Manage resource sets

##### 5.1.3.1 Create a resource set

A resource set is a group of resources and is similar to a project. After a user or user group is added to a resource set, the user or users in the user group can manage resources in the resource set. The resource set management feature enables you to resolve complex issues such as user authorization. If an organization has multiple projects, you can create multiple resource sets in the organization. This allows users to use and manage resources by resource set.

**Background information**

A resource set is a logical container of multiple resources. Each resource must belong to a resource set. When you create a resource, you must select a resource set for the resource. This way, resources are grouped by resource set. When you create an organization, the system creates a resource set for the organization by default. Resource sets are isolated from each other. An organization can have multiple resource sets, but each resource set can belong to only one organization.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.
4. On the Resource Sets page, click **Create Resource Set**.
5. In the **Create Resource Set** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in
the following table.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|

| Name | The name of the resource set. The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length. |
|---|---|
| Organization | The organization to which the resource set belongs. |
| Secret Level Access | The security level of the resource set. The security level of the resource set must be lower than the security level of the role that performs the current operation. Important The Secret Level Access and Security Level parameters are displayed only after the security level-based authorization feature is enabled by a platform administrator. To enable this feature, choose Configurations > Security Policies > Security Level Based Access. |
| Tag | The tags of the resource set. Add a tag: a. Click Add. b. Enter a tag key and a tag value. Note The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. It cannot start with acs:. Delete a tag: Click the icon next to the tag. |

6. Click **OK**.

This topic describes how to view resource sets and the details of a resource set.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.
4. On the Resource Sets page, view the created resource sets in the resource set list. You can
quickly find a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

> **Note:** You can move the pointer over User or User Group in the User column of a resource set to view the users or user groups that have permissions on the resource set.

5. Find the resource set that you want to view and click its name to go to the Resource Set
Details page.

| Sectio n or tab | Description |
|---|---|

| Basic Inform ation | This section displays the name, ID, organization, creator, creation time, tag, and security level of the resource set. |
|---|---|
| Resou rces | This tab displays the resource overview and the resources in the resource set. You can quickly find a resource instance by specifying filter conditions above the resource list, such as the type, region, tag, ID, name, and IP address of the resource. Note If a resource set is bound to a resource set of a managed cloud platform and the current user has permissions to manage the resource set of the managed cloud platform, the user can view the tabs of different cloud platforms on the Resources tab of the Resource Set Details page. The user can switch the tabs of different cloud platforms to view different cloud resources in the resource set. Resource overview: The resource overview section of the central cloud platform displays the numbers of different cloud resources. You can click the number of a cloud resource to go to the corresponding resource list page. The resource overview section of a managed cloud platform displays only the numbers of different cloud resources. After you click the number of a cloud resource, you are not navigated to the resource list page. Resource instance list: The resource instance list displays the information about resource instances. |
| Users | This tab displays the users and user groups that have permissions on the resource set. You can quickly find a user or user group by entering its name in the search box. For more information about resource set members, see Authorize users or user groups to access a resource set. |
| Multi- Cloud Resou rce Set | This tab displays the bound multi-cloud resource sets. For more information, see Manage multi-cloud resource sets. |

8. After the tags are modified, click **Close**.

##### 5.1.3.5 Manage resource set members

Authorize users or user groups to access a group of resources by granting them membership in a resource set. When users or user groups no longer need access to the resource set, administrators can quickly remove their authorization from the member list.

**Manage central cloud members of a resource set**

**Authorize a resource set to central cloud members**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resource Management** > **Resource Set**
**Management**.
4. On the **Resource Set Management** page, use the organization drop-down list above the
list, apply tag filters, or enter the resource set name in the search box to quickly locate a resource set.
5. On the **Members** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

6. Click **Member authorization** in the **Actions** column of the resource set.

> **Note:** Alternatively, click the resource set name. On the **Resource Set Details** page, go to the **Members** tab and click **Member authorization**.

7. In the **Member authorization** dialog box, select a role type and then select users or user
groups.

| Configuration item | Description |
|---|---|
| Select Role Type | In the Resource Pool column, select a central cloud resource pool from the drop- down list. In the Role Type column, select a role type. In the Role column, select a specific role. Note The Resource Pool column appears only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and the Resource Pool column is not displayed. You can select only preset roles or custom roles for the role type. |
| Select User or User Group | Based on the selected role type, select the users or user groups to authorize under Select User or User Group. Enter the user or user group name in the search box above the list to quickly find them. After selecting users or user groups, you can remove or clear the selected items on the right side under Selected Items. Note When authorizing users and user groups, limits apply to the number of selections per operation. Contact Alibaba Cloud technical support for specific limit configurations. |
| Authorization Validity Period | Control the validity period of the role within the resource set. After expiration, the role permissions become invalid. You can select Never Expire, By Duration, or Specific Date. |
| Validity Period | Configure this item when you select By Duration for Authorization Validity Period. Enter the specific validity duration in the input box. The upper limit is 365 days. The validity period starts from the time of configuration. |
| Expiration Date | Configure this item when you select Specific Date for Authorization Validity Period. In the Expiration Date time picker, select the exact expiration time, accurate to the second. The expiration time must be later than the current time. |

8. Click **Confirm**. After successful member authorization, the authorized users or user groups
appear on the Members tab of the resource set details page.

**View members authorized by the central cloud for a resource**

**set**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.
3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab to view members authorized for the
resource set. Enter a user or user group name in the search box above the list to perform fuzzy search.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

The member list includes the following information: **Type**, **Authorized Subject**, **Use Role**,
**Permission Validity Period**, **Authorization Status**, and **Expired At**.
**Type** includes user and user group.
**Authorized Subject** indicates the username or user group name of the member.
**Use Role** indicates the central cloud role assigned to the authorized member.
**Permission Validity Period** indicates the validity period during which the resource set
is authorized to the member. A hyphen (-) indicates permanent validity.
**Authorization Status** indicates the authorization status of the resource set. The system
displays **Enabled** during the validity period and **Disabled** after expiration.
**Expired At** indicates the expiration time of the authorization granted to the member for
the resource set. A hyphen (-) indicates permanent validity.

**Remove central cloud members from resource set**

**authorization**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.
3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

4. Remove authorization.
To remove a single member: Click **Remove Authorization** in the **Actions** column for the member. To remove multiple members: Select multiple users and user groups in the member list, then click **Remove Authorization** below the list.

> **Note:** When selecting users and user groups to remove authorization, each selection is subject to quantity limits. Contact Alibaba Cloud technical support for specific configuration of these limits.

5. Click **Confirm**. After you remove authorization, the user or users in the user group can no
longer access this resource set or use resources under this resource set.

**Change permission validity period for central cloud members in**

**a resource set**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.
3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

4. Click **Permission Renewal** in the **Actions** column for the member.
5. In the Permission Renewal dialog box, configure the authorization validity period.

| Configuration item | Description |
|---|---|
| Authorization Validity Period | You can control the validity period of a role within the resource set. After the validity period ends, the role permissions become invalid. You can select Never Expire, By Duration, or Specific Date. |
| Validity Period | Configure this item when you select By Duration for Authorization Validity Period. Enter the specific validity duration in the input box. The upper limit is 365 days. The validity period starts from the time you configure it. |
| Expiration Date | Configure this item when you select Specific Date for Authorization Validity Period. Select the specific expiration time in the Expiration Date time picker. The time is accurate to the second. The expiration time must be later than the current time. |

6. Click **Confirm**.

##### 5.1.3.6 Manage multi-cloud resource sets

After you bind a multi-cloud organization to a level-1 organization, you can bind a multi-cloud resource set to the resource sets of the level-1 organization and its subordinate organizations. After a multi-cloud resource set is bound, you can manage and schedule resources across multiple clouds. This improves resource utilization and management efficiency.

**Bind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Limits**

The default resource set of a level-1 organization cannot be bound to resource groups of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform. You must turn on the O&M switch to enable this capability.

**Prerequisites**

A multi-cloud organization is bound to the level-1 organization to which the resource set belongs. For more information, see Manage multi-cloud organizations. If you want to bind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform, you are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned. If you want to bind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a Resource Access Management (RAM) role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.
4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set
name above the resource set list.
5. On the **Resource Sets** page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click its
name.
6. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Multi-Cloud Resource Set** tab.
7. On the Multi-Cloud Resource Set tab, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**.
8. Bind a multi-cloud resource set.

| Operation | Procedure |
|---|---|
|   | Bind an existing resource set Association Method: Set this parameter to Select Existing Resource Set. |

|   | Cloud Platform: Select a managed Apsara Stack platform from this drop- down list. Multi-Cloud Organization: This drop-down list displays the name of the organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform bound to the organization to which the current resource set belongs by default. Multi-Cloud Resource Set: Select the resource set of the managed Apsara Stack platform to be bound from this drop-down list. Create and associate a resource set |
|---|---|
| Bind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform | Association Method: Set this parameter to Create and Associate Resource Set. Cloud Platform: Select the managed Apsara Stack platform to which the resource set to be created belongs from this drop-down list. Destination Resource Set Name: Enter the name of the resource set to be created. Destination Organization: Select the organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform to which the resource set to be created belongs. Secret Level Access: Select the security level of the resource set to be created. Note This parameter is displayed only if the security level-based access feature is enabled for the managed Apsara Stack platform. |

|   | Bind an existing resource group |
|---|---|

| Bind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform | Association Method: Set this parameter to Select Existing Resource Set. Cloud Platform: Select a managed Alibaba Cloud platform from this drop- down list. Resource Group: Select the resource group to be bound from this drop- down list. Create and associate a resource group Association Method: Set this parameter to Create and Associate Resource Set. Cloud Platform: Select the managed Alibaba Cloud platform to which the resource group to be created belongs from this drop-down list. |
|---|---|

|   | Destination Resource Group Name: Enter the name of the resource group to be created. Note The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. |
|---|---|

**Destination Resource Group ID**: Enter the identifier of the resource group
9. Click **OK**.
to be created.
0. After the multi-cloud resource set is bound, it is displayed on the Multi-Cloud Resource Set
tab. You can search for a multi-cloud resource set by cloud platform name in the search box above the multi-cloud resource set list. The identifier must be 3 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter. After a resource group is created, the identifier of the resource group cannot be changed.

**Unbind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

A resource set is bound to a multi-cloud resource set. If you want to unbind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform, you are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned. If you want to unbind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a RAM role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click its
name.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Multi-Cloud Resource Set** tab.
3. Search for a multi-cloud resource set by cloud platform name in the search box above the
multi-cloud resource set list.
4. Find the multi-cloud resource set that you want to manage and click **Unbind** in the **Actions**
column.
5. Click **OK**.

##### 5.1.3.7 Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set

**for a resource set**

You can specify a proxy administrator for a resource set on the Resource Sets page to assist you in managing the resource set. After you specify a proxy administrator for a resource set, a proxy user that maps to the proxy administrator is created. The proxy user can manage the resource set as the assigned role. For more information about how to specify a proxy administrator for an organization, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization.

**Specify a proxy administrator**

**Limits**

Only users of other level-1 organizations can be specified as proxy administrators. You can select only one role whose permission scope is Resource Sets as the proxy role.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.
4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set
name above the resource set list.
5. Find the resource set that you want to manage, move the pointer over the
icon in the
**Actions** column, and then select **Set Proxy Administrator**. In the Set Proxy Administrator
dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Current Resource Set | The name of the current resource set. This parameter cannot be modified. |
| Configuratio n Method | The configuration method. Set the value to Assign. |
| Select User | The user who is specified as the proxy administrator. You can select only one user from another level-1 organization. You can search for a user by organization and username above the user list. |
| Proxy Role | The role assigned to the proxy user. You can select only one role. |
| Proxy Scope | The permission scope of the proxy administrator, which is the same as the permission scope of the selected proxy role. This parameter cannot be modified. |
| Proxy Period | The start time and end time of the proxy. The proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations outside the specified time period. |

| Description | The description of the proxy administrator. |
|---|---|

6. Click **OK**.

**View the details of a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.
3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.
4. View the proxy administrator information in the list.

> **Note:** Proxy Administrator: a proxy user of the resource set. A proxy user is automatically created after a proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. The user who is specified as the proxy administrator performs proxy operations as the proxy user.
> Proxy Status: the proxy status. A proxy administrator can be in the Activating, Disabled, or Expired state. If a proxy administrator is in the Disabled or Expired state, the corresponding proxy user cannot log in.
> Activating: The proxy is within the validity period, and the proxy administrator is not disabled.
> Disabled: The proxy administrator is disabled.
> Expired: The proxy period expires, and the proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations.

Owner: the user who is specified as the proxy administrator. After the user logs in, the user can switch to the proxy user in the user center. For more information, see Enable the proxy mode as a proxy administrator for a proxy user.
5. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click its name.
6. On the **User Details** page, view the details of the proxy administrator.

**Modify a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.
3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.
4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Change** in the **Actions**
column.
5. In the **Edit Proxy Administrator** dialog box, select a proxy role, specify a proxy period,
and then enter a description.
6. Click **OK**.

**Disable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic. The proxy administrator is in the Activating or Expired state.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.
3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.
4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Disable** in the **Actions**
column.
5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Enable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic. The proxy administrator is in the Disabled state.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.
3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.
4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Enabled** in the **Actions**
column.
5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Delete a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.
1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.
2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.
3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.
4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Delete** in the **Actions**
column.
5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

##### 5.1.3.8 Delete a resource set

You can delete a resource set that you no longer need.

**Limits**

The default resource set of an organization cannot be deleted.

**Prerequisites**

Before you delete a resource set, make sure that the resource set does not have resources, users, or user groups. Otherwise, the resource set cannot be deleted.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.
4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set
name above the resource set list.
5. Find the resource set that you want to manage, move the pointer over the
icon in the
**Actions** column, and then select **Delete**.
6. In the **Confirm** message, click **OK**.

#### 5.1.4 Manage regions

You can manage the regions associated with organizations. Regions determine the geographical locations in which resources are created. Large-sized enterprises typically divide their business into different units. Each business unit may correspond to specific product lines or regions. In this case, they need to create different resources in specified regions. Enterprises can associate their organizations with regions to meet their requirements.

**Limits**

An organization must be associated with at least one region. Users in a general region associated with an organization cannot view the central region associated with the organization. After a level-1 organization is associated with a region, its subordinate organizations can also be associated with the region. If resources are activated in a region supported by an organization, you cannot disassociate the organization from the region. After an organization is associated with regions, the resources of the organization can be created only in the associated regions. An organization can be associated with multiple regions, and a region can be associated with multiple organizations.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Regions**.
4. In the left-side organization list, click the name of the organization that you want to
manage.
5. In the right-side Regions section, select or clear the name of the region that you want to
manage. If you select the name of a region, the organization is associated with the region. Then, you can create resources in this region. If you clear the name of a region, the organization is disassociated from the region. Then, you cannot create resources in this region.
6. Click **Update Association**.
7. If a multi-cloud organization is bound to a level-1 organization, you can also view the region
of the secondary cloud on the corresponding tab as an operations administrator.

> **Note:** Tabs of secondary clouds are displayed only in multi-cloud scenarios. You can only view region information, but cannot modify it.

#### 5.1.5 Change management

##### 5.1.5.1 Change the ownership of an organization

After you change the ownership of an organization, the resource sets and users of the organization are also moved to the destination organization.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot change the ownership of a level-1 organization. You cannot move organizations across level-1 organizations. When you change the ownership of an organization, you are not allowed to create instances in the organization and its subordinate organizations or resource sets. When you change the ownership of an organization, you are not allowed to change the ownership of existing instances in the organization and its subordinate organizations and resource sets.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.
4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.
5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click
its name.
6. On the right side of the Changes page, click **Change Organization Ownership**.
7. In the **Change Organization Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization
from the **New Organization** drop-down list.
8. Click **OK**.

##### 5.1.5.2 Change the ownership of a user

Changing the ownership of a user does not affect the original organization or resources.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot change the ownership of a user across level-1 organizations. You cannot change the organization to which you belong. Only your superior administrator can change the organization to which you belong.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.
4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.
5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click
its name.
6. On the right side of the Changes page, click **Users**.
7. On the Users page, find the user whose ownership you want to change and click **Change** in
the **Actions** column.
8. In the **Change Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization from the **New**
**Organization** drop-down list and select one or more roles from the **Assigned Roles** drop-
down list.
9. Click **OK**.

##### 5.1.5.3 Change the ownership of a resource set

If you change the ownership of a resource set, all the resources in this resource set are also moved to the destination organization.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot change the ownership of the default resource set of an organization. You cannot change the ownership of a resource set across level-1 organizations. When you change the ownership of a resource set, you are not allowed to create instances in the resource set. When you change the ownership of a resource set, you cannot change the ownership of existing instances in the resource set. If the ownership of a parent organization to which a resource set belongs is being changed, the ownership of the resource set cannot be changed.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.
4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.
5. Change the ownership of a resource set by using one of the following methods.
Method 1: a. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name. b. On the right side of the Changes page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click **Change Ownership** in the Actions column. Method 2: a. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click the icon to the left of the organization. Then, find the resource set that you want to manage in the organization and click the resource set name. b. On the right side of the Changes page, click **Change Resource Set Ownership**.
6. In the **Change Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization from the
**Change Resource Set To** drop-down list.
7. Click **OK**.

**What to do next**

1. On the **Changes** page, find the organization that you want to view in the left-side
organization tree and click its name.
2. On the right side of the Changes page, find the resource set that you want to view and click
its name or click **Details** in the Actions column.

Resources, Users, and Multi-Cloud Resource Set tabs. For more information about resource sets, see Manage resource sets.

### 5.2 User management

#### 5.2.1 User management

##### 5.2.1.1 Create a user

Administrators can create users individually or in batches and assign different roles to meet the access control requirements of different users.

**Background information**

An operations administrator can create users for all organizations, while an organization administrator can create users only for the current organization and its subordinate organizations. Each user can have only one login policy. The default policy does not restrict the login time or login IP address. To restrict the login time and IP address for different types of users, create a new login policy.

**Limits**

You can create a maximum of 100 users in batches at a time.

**Prerequisites**

Before you create a user, make sure that the organization and role are already created.

**Create a user**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise.**
3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users** > **Users.**
4. On the **System Users** tab, click **Create User.**
5. In the **Create User** dialog box, configure the user information.

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| User Name | The personal cloud platform account name of the user. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores ( ), periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@), and _ must be 2 to 64 characters in length. |
| Display Name | The display name, which can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), hyphens (-), spaces, and at signs (@), and must be 1 to 128 characters in length. |
| Role | Select a role for the user. |
| Organization | Select the organization to which the user belongs. |
| Remarks | Enter a description for the user. |
| Login Policy | The login policy restricts the login time and login IP address of the user. By default, the system automatically binds the default policy to a newly created user. |

| Access Method | The access method supports Console Access and Access with Permanent AccessKey Pair. You can select both options. Console Access: Allows the user to access the cloud console with a user name and password. Access with Permanent AccessKey Pair: After you create a user, the system automatically generates an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey Secret. This option allows access through APIs or other development tools. |
|---|---|
| Phone | Configure this parameter when you select Console Access as the access method. The mobile phone number of the user. The system uses this number to send SMS notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid mobile phone number. Note When you enter a mobile phone number, select the correct country code. |
| Landline | Configure this parameter when you select Console Access as the access method. The landline number of the user. It can contain only digits (0 to 9) and hyphens (- ), and must be 4 to 20 characters in length. |
| Email | Configure this parameter when you select Console Access as the access method. The email address of the user. The system uses this address to send email notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid email address. |
| DingTalk Key | Configure this parameter when you select Console Access as the access method. The key of the DingTalk robot. For more information about the configuration method, see DingTalk development documentation. |
| Message | Notify User by Email : When eanbled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni- manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user by email. Note Email notification requires a configured email server. Contact the on-site O&M engineer for assistance. After enabling this option, you can also select After creation, the user is notified of information such as the username and password by email. Notify User by DingTalk: When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni- manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user through DingTalk messages. |

6. Click **OK**. The user is created.
7. In the **Bind Resource Set** dialog box, click **Cancel** or **Bind Resource Set**.

> **Note:** When you bind a resource set, the system navigates to the user details page and opens the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box. For more information about adding a user to a resource set, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong.

**Create users in batches**

1. On the **System Users** tab, click **Batch Create Users**.

> **Note:** To create users in batches, you must first export the user template, fill in the user information as required, and then import the completed template.

2. In the **Batch Create Users** dialog box, click **User Creation Template**.
3. In the downloaded template file, fill in the user information as required.

| Name | Description 1 |
|---|---|
| Username | The personal cloud platform account name of the user. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores ( ), periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@), and _ must be 2 to 64 characters in length. |
| Display Name | The display name, which can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), hyphens (-), spaces, and at signs (@), and must be 1 to 128 characters in length. |
| Role | Enter the name of the target role for the user. You can view all roles by selecting Permissions > Role Permissions. |
| Organization | Enter the path of the target organization for the user. Important The path must start from the root organization, for example, "root/level-1 organization/level-2 organization". If the root organization name has been customized, use the custom name. |
| Login Policy | Enter the name of the login policy for the user. You can view all login policies by selecting Permissions > Access Control. |
| Remarks | Enter a description for the user. |
| Console Access | Enter Y or N. The default value is Y. After you enable this option, the user can access the cloud console with a user name and password. |

| Access with Permanent AccessKey Pair | Enter Y or N. The default value is Y. After you enable this option, the system automatically generates an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey Secret after user is created. This option allows access through APIs or other development tools. |
|---|---|
| Country Code | Enter the international dialing code. |
| Mobile Phone | Enter the mobile phone number of the user. The system uses this number to send SMS notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid mobile phone number. |
| Landline | The landline number of the user. It can contain only digits (0 to 9) and hyphens (- ), and must be 4 to 20 characters in length. |
| Email | The email address of the user. The system uses this address to send email notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid email address. |
| Enable Email Notification | Enter Y or N. The default value is N. When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user by email. Note Email notification requires a configured email server. Contact the on-site O&M engineer for assistance. |
| Enable DingTalk Notification | Enter Y or N. The default value is N. When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user through DingTalk messages. |
| DingTalk Key | The key of the DingTalk robot. For more information about the configuration method, see DingTalk development documentation. Note You must enable DingTalk notification. |
| The password is sent to you by email | Enter Y or N. The default value is N. Note You must enable email notification. |

4. After you complete and save the template file, click **Upload Template** in the **Import**
wizard. After the upload completes, click **Next**.

> **Note:** After you upload the template file, the system automatically validates the user information. If the file contains errors, the system cannot create the users. You must modify the template file locally and then click **Re-upload**.

5. In the **OK** wizard, preview and check the user information to import, and then click **OK**.
6. (Optional) After the system creates the task, you can click **Task List** in the dialog box to go
to the asynchronous task page and view the creation results.

##### 5.2.1.2 View the system user list and details

On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, you can view system user information.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users****> Users**.
4. Click the **System User** tab.
5. View user information in the system user list.
6. Use the drop-down list or advanced filter settings above the list to quickly find users.
7. Click the name of a user or **View Details** in the **Actions** column.
8. On the **User Details** page, view user details.

| Item | Description |
|---|---|

| Basic information | In the upper part of the page, view the basic information of the user, includingU ser Name, Display Name, Password, Organization, UID, Mobile Phone Number, Landline, Email Address, Most Recent Login, External System Association, DingTalk Token, Remarks, User Role, User Group Role, Access Method, and Multi-Cloud Role. Note Click next to Password to view the user's initial password. If the user has changed the password, you cannot view the initial password. Click Reset Password next to Password to reset the password of the user to a random initial password. |
|---|---|
| Resource Set | The Resource Set tab displays the resource sets that the user has joined. For more information, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong. |

In the Preset Roles & Custom Roles drop-down list, select a role to view the specific permissions of the role. The RAM Authorization section displays the RAM authorization roles of the user. |

##### 5.2.1.3 Modify basic information of a user

You can modify and update user information as needed.

**Limits**

You cannot edit the information of proxy administrator users. You cannot modify the user name or the organization to which the user belongs.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users****> Users**.
4. Click the **System Users** tab.
5. Quickly find a user by using the drop-down list or advanced filter settings above the list.
6. Click **Edit** in the **Actions** column of the target user.
7. In the **Edit User** dialog box, modify the user information. For more information about the
configuration items, see Create a user.

> **Note:** When editing a user, you can configure the **Console Access** access mode only.

8. Click **OK**.

##### 5.2.1.4 Manage the roles of a user

This topic describes how to manage the roles of a user.

**Assign a role of the central cloud to a user**

**Limits**

You can assign up to 10 Resource Access Management (RAM) roles to a user, including roles directly assigned to the user and roles assigned to the user group to which the user belongs.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.
4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab. Search for a user by using the search box
or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.
5. Click the
icon in the **Actions** column and select **Role Authorization**.
6. In the **Role Authorization** dialog box, add or remove roles.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| User Name | The username. This parameter cannot be modified. |
| Select Role | Add roles: Select the roles that you want to assign to the user in the left section and click Add. Remove roles: Select the roles that you want to revoke from the user in the right section and click Remove. |
| Select Multi- Cloud Role | The multi-cloud role. This parameter is displayed in multi-cloud environments. You can assign roles of managed Apsara Stack platforms and managed Alibaba Cloud platforms to the user. For more information, see the Assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user and Assign a role of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to a user sections of this topic. |
| Inherit User Group Role | The roles assigned to the user group to which the user belongs are displayed. |

7. Click **OK**.

**Assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to an organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform. You are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

**Limits**

Only one role of the managed Apsara Stack platform can be assigned to a user. When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user that is not a level-1 organization administrator, you can select only a role whose management scope is Resource Sets. When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a level-1 organization administrator, you can select a role whose management scope is Resource Sets or the organization administrator role.
1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter and select a level-1
organization that is bound to the managed Apsara Stack platform from the **Organization** drop-down list to filter users in the level-1 organization.

> **Note:** You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the
icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **Role Authorization**.
3. In the **Select Multi-Cloud Role** section of the **Role Authorization** dialog box, select the
role of the managed Apsara Stack platform that you want to assign to the user.
**Assign or change the role**: Select the desired role from the drop-down list next to
Apsara Stack.
**Remove the role**: Click
next to the role to revoke the role from the user.
4. Click **OK**.
5. In the **Role Authorization** message, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**. On the
User Details page, bind a multi-cloud resource set to the user.

**Assign a role of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to a user**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to the Alibaba Cloud account of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform. You are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a RAM role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Limits**

Only one RAM role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform can be assigned to a user.
1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter. In the **Organization**
drop-down list, select a level-1 organization that is bound to the managed Alibaba Cloud platform to filter users in the level-1 organization.

> **Note:** You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the
icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **Role Authorization**.
3. In the **Select Multi-Cloud Role** section of the **Role Authorization** dialog box, select the
required role.

| Operation | Procedure |
|---|---|
|   | If the user is not assigned a role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you can assign a RAM role to the user. i. Click Authorize Now next to Public Cloud. ii. In the Basic Information and Policies step of theC reate RAM Role dialog box, configure the basic information and policies of the RAM role. |

| er Guide·Enterpris | e Apsara Uni-manage |
|---|---|
|   | Role Name: The role name must be 5 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-). The value must start with a letter or digit. Example: ecs-readonly-role. Organization: the organization to which the user belongs. Bind User: the username. Remarks: the information about the permissions and use scenarios of the RAM role. Permission Scope: the permission scope. Valid values: Resource Group and Alibaba Cloud Account. You can select Replace with PowerUserAccess or Continue to Use AdministratorAccess. Replace with PowerUserAccess: This policy is recommended. |

##### 5.2.1.5 Modify multi-cloud roles

This topic describes how to modify multi-cloud roles. You can assign a multi-cloud role to a user or change the multi-cloud role of a user.

**Modify roles of a managed Apsara Stack platform**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to an organization of a managed Apsara Stack platform. You are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

**Limits**

Only one role of the managed Apsara Stack platform can be assigned to a user. When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user that is not a level-1 organization administrator, you can select only a role whose management scope is Resource Sets. When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a level-1 organization administrator, you can select a role whose management scope is Resource Sets or the organization administrator role.
1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.
4. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter and select the level-1
organization that is bound to a managed Apsara Stack platform from the **Organization** drop-down list to filter users in the level-1 organization.

> **Note:** You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

5. Find the user that you want to manage, click the
icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **Edit Multi-Cloud Role**.
6. In the **Edit Multi-Cloud Role** dialog box, select the role of the managed Apsara Stack
platform.
**Assign a role or change the role** : Select the required role from the drop-down list next
to Apsara Stack.
**Remove a role**: Move the pointer over the drop-down list and click the
icon next to the role.
7. Click **OK**.
8. In the **Role Authorization** message, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**. On the
User Details page, bind a multi-cloud resource set to the user.

**Modify roles of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform**

**Prerequisites**

The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to the Alibaba Cloud account of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform. You are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a Resource Access Management (RAM) role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Limits**

Only one RAM role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform can be assigned to a user.
1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter. In the **Organization**
drop-down list, select the level-1 organization that is bound to a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to filter users in the level-1 organization.

> **Note:** You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the
icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **Edit Multi-Cloud Role**.
3. In the **Edit Multi-Cloud Role** dialog box, select the role of the managed Alibaba Cloud
platform.

##### 5.2.1.6 Manage the resource sets to which users belong

**belong**

When the resource sets to which a user belongs change, adjust them through resource set management.

**Central Cloud**

**Add users to central cloud resource sets**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users****> Users**.
4. Click the **System Users** tab. Use the drop-down list or advanced filters above the list to
quickly find users.
5. On the **System Users** page, click
in the **Actions** column of a user and select **Resource**
**Set Management**. The system displays the **Resource Sets** tab by default.

> **Note:** You can also click the username to go to the **Resource Sets** tab.

6. Under the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Connected Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only Central Cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

7. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.
8. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the role that the user will assume in the
resource set. In the **Select Resource Set** list, select the resource sets to which you want to add the user.
9. Click OK. The system successfully adds the user to the resource sets. The added resource
sets appear in the resource set list.

**Remove users from central cloud resource sets**

1. Under the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The Central Cloud and Connected Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only Central Cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. Above the resource set list, query resource sets by role.
3. In the resource set list, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.
4. In the **Confirm** dialog box, click OK.

**Connected cloud**

**Add users to connected cloud Resource Sets**

**Prerequisites**

The user has been granted a connected cloud role. You must be an operations administrator (bound to the connected cloud operations administrator role) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the connected cloud organization administrator role).
1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud tab.

> **Note:** In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.
3. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the resource sets to which you want to add
the user.

> **Note:** **Role for Joining Resource Set**: Displays the connected cloud resource pool and connected cloud role. You cannot modify this setting.
> **Select Resource Set**: Displays the names of central cloud resource sets that are bound to connected cloud resource sets. Enter a resource set name in the text box to quickly find a resource set.

4. Click **Confirm**.

**Remove users from connected cloud Resource Sets**

**Prerequisites**

You must be an operations administrator (bound to the connected cloud operations administrator role) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the connected cloud organization administrator role).
1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud tab.

> **Note:** In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. In the list of resource sets, view the resource sets to which the user belongs.

> **Note:** The resource set names are those of central cloud resource sets bound to connected cloud resource sets.

3. In the list of resource sets, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.
4. In the **Confirm** dialog box, click **Confirm**.

**Connected cloud Public Cloud**

**Add users to the connected cloud Public Cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

The user has been granted a connected cloud Public Cloud role. You are an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the connected cloud Public Cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the connected cloud Public Cloud primary account).
1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud Public Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The central cloud and connected cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

2. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.
3. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the resource sets to which you want to add
the user.

> **Note:** **Role for Joining Resource Set**: Displays the connected cloud Public Cloud resource pool and role. You cannot modify this setting.
> **Select Resource Set**: Displays the names of central cloud resource sets bound to connected cloud Public Cloud resource groups. Enter a resource set name in the text box to quickly find a resource set.

4. Click **Confirm**.

**Remove users from the connected cloud Public Cloud resource**

**set**

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the connected cloud Public Cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the connected cloud Public Cloud primary account).
1. On the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the connected cloud Public Cloud tab.

> **Note:** The central cloud and connected cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

2. In the list of resource sets, view the resource sets to which the user belongs.

> **Note:** The resource set name is the name of the central cloud resource set bound to the connected cloud Public Cloud resource group.

3. In the list of resource sets, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.
4. In the **Confirm Removal** dialog box, click **Confirm**.

##### 5.2.1.9 Configure MFA settings

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security measure that significantly enhances account security. It requires users to bind a virtual MFA device such as Alibaba Cloud app to their accounts. This way, users must prove their identity by using multiple verification methods when they log on.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.
4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.
5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the
user list.
6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the
icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **MFA Settings**.
7. In the **MFA Settings** dialog box, turn on or off MFA Settings and click **OK**.

> **Note:** : MFA is enabled.
> : MFA is disabled.

| MFA Status | Description |
|---|---|

| Enabled/Unbou nd | When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, the Bind Virtual MFA Device page appears to ask the user to bind an MFA device. |
|---|---|
| Enabled/Bound | When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, a dynamic MFA code is required for authentication. If you want to unbind an MFA device from a user, selectU nbind Current Device in the MFA Settings dialog box. After you unbind the MFA device, the MFA device becomes invalid. |
| Disabled/Boun d | When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, a dynamic MFA code is still required for authentication. If you want to unbind an MFA device from a user, selectU nbind Current Device in the MFA Settings dialog box. After you unbind the MFA device, the MFA device becomes invalid. |

| Disabled/Unbo und | When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, no dynamic MFA code is required for authentication. |
|---|---|
